title: A latent surrogate that says when not to trust it
description: Latent surrogate with a trust card: error, speed and calibration against the full solver. Full model: steady 2-D advection-diffusion-reaction of a pollutant released by a Gaussian source, -kappa * lap(u) + v . grad(u) + k u = f(x; xs), u = 0 on the boundary of [0, 1]^2, finite differences (upwind convection) on a 96 x 96 grid, sparse direct solve.
